title: Lipschitz extension (Simon 2.1.2) and Rademacher theorem (Simon 2.1.4)
statement: (1.2) For every metric space X (Lean X : Type with MetricSpace X), every nonempty A ⊆ X and every f : A → ℝ that is Lipschitz for the subspace metric (LipschitzWith K f for some K : ℝ≥0), there is F : X → ℝ which is Lipschitz (∃ K, LipschitzWith K F), has the same least Lipschitz constant, lipConst F = lipConst f where lipConst g := sInf {K : ℝ≥0 | LipschitzWith K g}, and satisfies F a = f a for all a ∈ A. (1.4) For every n ∈ ℕ and every Lipschitz f : ℝⁿ → ℝ (ℝⁿ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), f is Fréchet differentiable at volume-almost every point of ℝⁿ.
